fieldValues.title: Render one section of a composition: what should `render composition --container` mean, so srs-rust#1510 has a ruling?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Checked 2026-11-04 against srs-rust origin/master 99e5594 with release v0.1.0-build.576. The spec composition has nine container-subset sections, one per Part. `srs render composition --container <Part>` renders all nine sections against that one container (about 905 kB instead of about 100 kB): on render, --container silently re-points every section. `--instance` scopes to a record and its subtree but cannot name a concept container. srs#983 therefore splits the rendered markdown by headings in a script (`scripts/lib/agent-pages.mjs`). srs-rust#1510 is planned (a --section selector; one meaning for --container) but states `Ruling: none`. RFC-043 puts order on the Container and RFC-036 keeps presentation in the view layer; neither says what selecting part of a composition means, and srs#851 (compositions stop naming containers, RFC-050 Draft) may change the sections' shape.
fieldValues.tensions: Option A: a --section selector (by index or title) renders one section with its own typeFilter and dispatch; --container on render is refused when every section names its own container. Option B: --container keeps one meaning on render, scope the section whose source is that container. Option C: wait for RFC-050 (srs#851), since sections that no longer name containers change what selecting one means. Portability and the group's lean (Office, Portability, Evolution) favour a core render over a client splitter; Evolution warns against fixing a CLI meaning RFC-050 may remove.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: 1. Does selecting a section belong to the render request (CLI and WASM) or to a Composition of its own per Part? 2. Should --container on render be refused or redefined? 3. Does RFC-050 settle this first? Evidence that would choose: RFC-050's section shape once it leaves Draft, and whether other publishers (muDemocracy site) need per-section pages.
fieldValues.blocking: srs-rust#1510 cannot be promoted; srs#983's agent pages keep a heading splitter in a script (SP-123).
fieldValues.next_action: Owner: choose A, B or C. Recommendation: B for --container (one meaning, never a silent re-point) with A's selector, recorded as a short decision under RFC-036 (presentation in the view layer); then srs-rust#1510 becomes ready work.
